themes_detail.label: Dead Animal Spike
themes_detail.summary: Dead animal complaints surged to 10 this week versus a baseline of 1.8 per week over the prior 8 weeks—a 471% spike (z-score: 6.88)—suggesting either a pest outbreak, wildlife die-off event, or sanitation failure in Bay Ridge/Dyker Heights this week.
evidence: 10 dead animal complaints this week vs. 1.8 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (z-score: 6.88)
471% increase represents most extreme single-week spike in dataset
Concentrated timing suggests acute event rather than chronic condition
reporting_angles: Interview DSNY and Parks Dept on whether they've identified source (disease, poison, infrastructure failure) and scope of problem
Canvass affected blocks to map geographic pattern and gather resident accounts of where bodies were found

themes_detail.label: Illegal Dumping Surge
themes_detail.summary: Illegal dumping complaints hit 11 this week, more than double the 8-week average of 5.1 per week (115% spike, z-score: 5.04)—a shift that coincides with the dead animal spike and suggests potential environmental or waste-handling crisis in the district this week.
evidence: 11 illegal dumping complaints this week vs. 5.1 weekly average (115% increase, z-score: 5.04)
Concurrent spike with dead animal complaints suggests possible connected sanitation or waste-handling breakdown
Aligns with recurring community board budget request for 'garbage collection and recycling infrastructure'
reporting_angles: Cross-reference dumping and dead animal complaints geographically to identify hotspot blocks or neighborhoods
Investigate whether DSNY staffing, collection schedules, or equipment failures are contributing to both issues

themes_detail.label: Abandoned Bikes Crisis
themes_detail.summary: Abandoned bike complaints surged to 6 last week versus a baseline of 0.9 per week—a 586% spike (z-score: 6.57)—indicating a sudden influx of discarded bikes cluttering streets and public space in Bay Ridge/Dyker Heights over the past week.
evidence: 6 abandoned bike complaints last week vs. 0.9 weekly average (586% increase, z-score: 6.57)
Statistically extreme spike suggests sudden event or change in dumping behavior
May signal end-of-season dockless bike abandonment or theft-recovery dumping
reporting_angles: Check with bike-share operators (Citi Bike, etc.) whether they've pulled service or experienced fleet issues in Bay Ridge
Interview NYPD on whether bike theft rings are stripping and abandoning bikes in the district

themes_detail.label: Electrical Hazards Spike
themes_detail.summary: Electrical complaints hit 5 two weeks ago versus a baseline of 0.6 per week—a 700% spike (z-score: 5.11)—reflecting a spike in reported electrical code violations or hazards in Bay Ridge/Dyker Heights over the past 2 weeks.
evidence: 5 electrical complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 0.6 weekly average (700% increase, z-score: 5.11)
Concurrent with heat/hot water complaints (1,694 total over 90 days), suggesting building-wide infrastructure stress
DOB filings show 446 total permits, mostly alterations (382), which could mask electrical work quality issues
reporting_angles: Request DOB inspection data for electrical violations in Bay Ridge over past 3 months; cross-check against complaints
Interview Con Edison on whether grid strain, outages, or storm damage preceded electrical complaints

themes_detail.label: Illegal Tree Damage Escalation
themes_detail.summary: Illegal tree damage complaints reached 10 last week versus a baseline of 2.4 per week—a 321% spike (z-score: 4.84)—suggesting a pattern of property owners or contractors unlawfully removing or damaging street trees in Bay Ridge/Dyker Heights last week.
evidence: 10 illegal tree damage complaints last week vs. 2.4 weekly average (321% increase, z-score: 4.84)
Spike coincides with fall/early winter season when landscaping work accelerates
Related complaints include 'Door/Window' (182% spike, 19 vs. 6.8 avg) and 'Damaged Tree' (237 total over 90 days), suggesting building/property alteration activity
reporting_angles: Map illegal tree damage complaints against active DOB alteration permits (382 filed in last 90 days) to identify contractors or developments responsible
Interview Parks Department on enforcement capacity and penalties for illegal tree removal; examine whether fines deter repeat violators
